name: Ritz Crisp & Thins Oven-Baked Potato and Wheat Chips
whyItWorks: Ultra-thin, oven-baked crisps made from potato and wheat flour with 50% less fat than standard chips. Fragile structure dissolves quickly upon chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the bag. A gentle alternative to greasy fried potato chips.
